railway_alerts.title: Central Railway Sunday Mega Block: Matunga - Mulund Fast Lines
railway_alerts.description: Central Railway operates Sunday Mega Block between Matunga and Mulund UP and DOWN fast lines from 11:05 hrs to 15:55 hrs. All fast services are diverted on UP/DOWN slow lines between Mulund and Matunga halting at all stations between Mulund and CSMT.
railway_alerts.impact: 15 to 20 minutes delay on fast corridor; all fast locals operate as slow between Mulund and Dadar.
railway_alerts.advice: Commuters are advised to board Slow corridor services directly from Thane, Ghatkopar, or Kurla.
railway_alerts.source: Chief Public Relations Officer (CPRO), Central Railway, CSMT

railway_alerts.title: Harbour Line Mega Block: Panvel - Vashi UP & DOWN Lines
railway_alerts.description: Mega block operated on UP and DOWN Harbour lines between Panvel and Vashi from 11:05 hrs to 16:05 hrs. Belapur/Panvel services to CSMT remain suspended during the block. Special suburban locals operate between CSMT and Vashi.
railway_alerts.impact: Harbour line services beyond Vashi cancelled; Trans-Harbour line services available between Thane-Vashi/Nerul.
railway_alerts.advice: Commuters can use Trans-Harbour line via Thane to travel towards Panvel/Belapur.
railway_alerts.source: Divisional Railway Manager (DRM), Mumbai Division, Central Railway

railway_alerts.title: Introduction of 10 New AC Local Services on Main Line
railway_alerts.description: Central Railway has augmented suburban capacity by introducing 10 additional Air-Conditioned (AC) EMU services on CSMT-Kalyan, Titwala, and Badlapur routes. Fast AC services will now also halt at Diva station during morning and evening rush hours.
railway_alerts.impact: Increased AC frequency with 15-20 min intervals during peak hours.
railway_alerts.advice: Tickets and AC Season passes valid across all upgraded services. Check Coach 4 & 9 for Women's AC Coach.
railway_alerts.source: CPRO Central Railway Press Release No. 2026/09/14

railway_alerts.title: Kalyan-Kasara Ghat Section Precautionary Speed Restriction
railway_alerts.description: Engineering caution order enforced with a 40 km/h speed restriction between Thansit, Khardi, and Kasara (Thal Ghat section) for track tamping and overhead equipment (OHE) inspection. Kasara locals may run 5-8 minutes behind schedule.
railway_alerts.impact: Kasara bound locals experiencing 5 to 8 minutes transit buffer.
railway_alerts.advice: Allow extra 10 minutes connection time when boarding long-distance trains from Kalyan.
railway_alerts.source: Senior Divisional Operating Manager (Sr. DOM), Mumbai CR

railway_alerts.title: Platform Operational Revision at Thane Station
railway_alerts.description: To decongest evening crowd on Platform No. 1 and 2, all Thane originating CSMT Slow local services will strictly arrive and depart from Platform No. 2. Platform No. 3 is dedicated exclusively for through slow locals coming from Kalyan/Dombivli.
railway_alerts.impact: Platform allocation streamlined for Thane originating commuters.
railway_alerts.advice: Board Thane originating trains from PF 2 for guaranteed vacant seating.

railway_alerts.title: Trans-Harbour Corridor (Thane - Vashi / Panvel) Running Normal
railway_alerts.description: Suburban train services on Thane-Turbhe-Vashi and Thane-Nerul-Panvel Trans-Harbour lines are running strictly as per working timetable without delays. 12-car rakes operating smoothly with 8-minute headway during morning peak.
railway_alerts.impact: Smooth transit connecting Central suburbs with Navi Mumbai nodes.
railway_alerts.advice: Platform 9 and 10 at Thane station handle all Trans-Harbour departures.
railway_alerts.source: Traffic Control Room, Central Railway Mumbai

railway_alerts.title: UTS Mobile Ticketing App: Station Geofence Radius Enforced
railway_alerts.description: CR reminds passengers that paperless suburban tickets and monthly season passes must be booked through UTS on Mobile app strictly outside 50 meters of station track perimeter and before boarding the train to avoid without-ticket penalties.
railway_alerts.impact: Ticket checking drive active across all suburban gate turnstiles and FOBs.
railway_alerts.advice: Book your UTS ticket before entering the station foot-over-bridge (FOB).
